description.narrative: (Zambia): .The USAID Let's Read Project is USAID's flagship education activity that supports the Ministry of General Education (MOGE) to improve reading skills of approximately 1.4 million children in pre-primary through Grade 3 in public and community primary schools across five target provinces. In line with MOGE's 2014 roll-out of the Primary Literacy Program and revised curriculum, the activity will promote grade-level reading with comprehension and writing in Zambia's seven official local languages of instruction and address the provision of quality education - one of the major challenges in Zambia's growing education system. Interventions will ensure that teachers are proficient in literacy instruction to teach students essential literacy skills needed to learn other subjects. Let's Read will support teacher training; development of teaching and learning materials; strengthening school management and assessment; performance tracking; ; and engagement of parent, community, and private sector partners to broaden support, involvement, and oversight in education. The activity will incorporate innovative approaches such as broadcasting literacy lessons through radio and teacher training content to improve reading levels among children...Developing foundational learning skills will result in more children progressing academically, and ultimately being able to participate meaningfully in Zambia's social and economic development. The activity also establishes public-private partnerships to leverage resources to support the delivery of quality education to improve learning outcomes. Let's Read contributes Development Objective (DO)4: Quality of Primary Education Strengthened to Improve Learning Outcomes; and directly to the Administration policy priority of promoting healthy, educated, and productive populations in partner countries to drive inclusive and sustainable development and support U.S. prosperity and security objectives....
